subscores.name: overall
subscores.reasoning:
I recomputed the model's headline numbers from the original workbook and annotation in R and plain Python, without running any of the model's scripts. Nearly everything checked reproduces. This is an exceptionally accurate, complete and well-sourced deliverable.

**Deliverables.** The proposal comes as PDF (24 pages), DOCX (23 tables, 8 figures), HTML and Markdown, all with the same complete content. Alongside it are an evidence ledger (453 cited values, each with cell ranges and method), QC tables and figures.

**Task coverage** (all required elements are present):
- **Recommendation first:** keep the programme conditionally, take PSLN-344 forward, stop PSLN-212 as a lead, and fund to a July 2027 gate.
- **How the asset looks:** a scorecard.
- **What we give up if dropped:** set out, along with an honest case for dropping.
- **Mechanism of action:** a 9-step chain, each step labelled by evidence type (knockout, inhibitor or observed), plus the gaps: no STING knockout and no Mn²⁺-only control.
- **Biomarkers:** staged from early engagement to antibody and T-cell response, with animal-level separation and human-accessible equivalents.
- **Target demographic:** adults 65+, with segments and the inputs market research needs to size the TAM; no invented market figures.
- **Next steps:** Step 0 plus Studies 1–7, each with population, comparators, endpoints, read-outs, timing, power and a decision rule; three gates.
- **Considered and ruled out:** a table of options and rejected explanations.
- It correctly questions the "small-molecule STING agonist" framing: the data show a cyclic-dinucleotide liposome that works only as a vaccine adjuvant (0/7 survive without vaccine in S15-H).

**Numbers checked against the raw data, all matching:**
- Survival counts in every challenge block, and the pooled totals:
  - 18/21 vs 3/21 vs 0/21 in the three core experiments; 42/45, 8/45, 1/45 across all six as printed;
  - 21/24 when challenged 2–3 days after dosing; 14/21 at day 60; 24/24 in young mice; 12/14 in the other strains and in 14-month mice.
- Clopper–Pearson confidence intervals: 64–97%, 43–85%, 68–97%, 5–42%.
- Log-rank tests stratified by experiment: p=5.6×10⁻⁷ (PSLN-344 vs PSLN-212), 0.005 (day 60 vs young), 0.44 (vs untreated animals).
- Tukey p-values: 3.7×10⁻⁸ (Ifnb1), 5.7×10⁻⁶ and 2.2×10⁻⁶ (HAI), 0.86 (encapsulation efficiency), and the brain Tnf 95% CI of −0.98 to +1.53.
- Age × Mn²⁺ interaction p=0.0004: this holds on the log scale (I got 0.00039); on the linear scale it would be 0.11.
- Geometric mean titres and fold ratios: 8.0×, 9.2×, 18.6×; booster ratios 3.5× and 11.5×.
- Weight nadir 96.4% vs 98.2%, with Tukey CI −6.7 to +3.1.
- Power figures: 99%, 60%, 43%, 46%, 83%, and group sizes n=11, 22 and 14.
- "34 read-outs, median 70% vs 19% of the young response" reproduces exactly.
- Mechanism numbers from S01, S02, S05, S07 and S11.

**Planted data problems it caught, each verified:**
- S03-B column headers rotated: the S13 per-animal quotients match exactly, shifted by one column.
- S03-I and S03-J group labels conflict with their body-weight tables.
- S06-C and S06-D are identical for all 28 animals.
- Body-weight values in S15-C are copies of S15-I.
- S11-A and S11-B share 35 of 100 values.
- The second S09-A panel is labelled 16 h but holds the 72 h values from S01-A.
- S07-C has the same label on both groups.
- Stated group sizes differ from the data, including the annotation placing the short Sham group in S09-B when it is actually in S09-F.

External knowledge is labelled as such, and the limits of the work are disclosed honestly.

**Minor issues:**
- The log scale used for the interaction test is not stated next to that p-value.
- The 34-read-out summary leaves out the day-8 measures without saying so in the text; Figure 3 shows which read-outs are included.
- At 24 pages the document is dense for a committee, though Section 1 stands alone.
- The DOCX was not checked in Word, which the model disclosed.
- There is no budget, which the model also disclosed, as no cost data were available.

None of these affects the substance.
